findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_crew_websites, get_crew · Public sink: list_crew_websites, get_crew, analyze_vector_fanout, analyze_ai_mode, analyze_spotlight_visualizer, analyze_spotlight_focus, analyze_ai_overviews, analyze_orbital_drift, analyze_content_summarizer, analyze_embedding_separation, analyze_keyword_separation, analyze_spotlight_author, analyze_query_coverage, analyze_query_proximity, analyze_field_relevance, analyze_html_bm25, analyze_query_expansion, analyze_content_depth, analyze_semantic_focus, analyze_meta_title_vector_similarity, analyze_heading_vector_similarity, analyze_meta_title_tf_idf, analyze_meta_description_tf_idf, analyze_html_tf_idf, analyze_homepage_relevance, analyze_search_citation, analyze_wikidata_entity · Destructive: analyze_vector_fanout, analyze_ai_mode, analyze_spotlight_visualizer, analyze_spotlight_focus, analyze_ai_overviews, analyze_orbital_drift, analyze_content_summarizer, analyze_embedding_separation, analyze_keyword_separation, analyze_spotlight_author, analyze_query_coverage, analyze_query_proximity, analyze_field_relevance, analyze_html_bm25, analyze_query_expansion, analyze_content_depth, analyze_semantic_focus, analyze_meta_title_vector_similarity, analyze_heading_vector_similarity, analyze_meta_title_tf_idf, analyze_meta_description_tf_idf, analyze_html_tf_idf, analyze_homepage_relevance, analyze_search_citation, analyze_wikidata_entity.
